source_correlation.finding: QWebpHandler::ensureScanned peeks sizeof(WebPBitstreamFeatures) and rejects shorter data. The source struct has five int fields and five uint32_t padding fields, consistent with a 40-byte minimum on this Windows target.
source_correlation.interpretation: This source observation explains the 38-byte solid WebP rejection and 56-byte patterned success; no native patch, rebuilt plugin or general security verdict is claimed.

observations.scope: One exact trusted 38-byte fixture; no malformed-input fuzzing or general security verdict

independent_webp_decode.conclusion: Locked Pillow 13.0.0 with libwebp 1.6.0 decodes the exact same 38-byte fixture and all 256 RGBA pixels match, with truncated-image loading disabled. This supports a Qt-specific decoder compatibility failure for the fixture rather than a malformed encoder result.

observations.scope: One trusted saved fixture, no native changes, full suite, OpenGL context, network or packet effects

production_baseline_comparison.conclusion: The exact same 38-byte WebP fails with InvalidDataError in verified production Qt 6.11.2 and candidate 6.11.3, while Pillow succeeds. This particular limitation was not introduced by the candidate upgrade; it remains unresolved.
